name: Masked Local-Global Ray Sampling
definition: A ray sampling strategy to extract contextual and geometric information in 2D projection by segmenting informative foreground regions and sampling X-rays on patches and outside regions.
summary: Masked Local-Global Ray Sampling is an X-ray volume rendering strategy that partitions foreground masks into non-overlapping windows to prioritize local structure perception while sampling global context, avoiding uninformative background rays.
